data_fields.name: combat_action_weights
data_fields.donor_constant: hold 0.0, attack 0.85, stunt 0.05, item 0.0, flee 0.05 (normalised before the roll)

data_fields.name: flee_exit_exclusion
data_fields.donor_constant: exclude the room the mob came from

best_idea: Drive NPC action choice from a weighted per-tick table that is data per archetype, with an idle/roam/combat/flee state machine on top.
decision_why: Keep the weighted table as archetype data and the room-presence state change; reject uniform random targeting and the aimless flee walk, and test that every table key has a handler (the donor has a key mismatch and a typo).
acceptance: A seeded server test over 1000 ticks with one player and weights {attack 0.85, stunt 0.05, flee 0.05} asserts about 850 attack steps (within 3%) and about 50 flee transitions; a second test fails if any table key lacks a handler.
